name: tpdf
expr: y_s = tpdf(0, 5); y_t = tpdf(1, 5); y_v = tpdf(xs, 10); y_inf0 = tpdf(0, Inf); y_inf1 = tpdf(1, Inf); y_inf25 = tpdf(2.5, Inf); y_big = tpdf(0, 1e10); y_n0 = tpdf(0, 0); y_nneg = tpdf(0, -1); y_nan = tpdf(NaN, 5);
comment: Sig: y = tpdf(x, nu). Student's t PDF via lgamma-stable form. nu=Inf -> Gaussian limit (1/sqrt(2π))·exp(-x²/2). nu<=0 or NaN -> NaN. NaN x -> NaN.
